claim: A search of Web Summit's public session pages found 27 Brazil-tied speakers.
Of the Brazil-tied appearances, 7 were officials, 2 were journalists, and 18 were founders or team members.
The Brazil Pavilion has stand E369 at Web Summit.
The Brazil Pavilion runs its own programme from 10 to 12 November, with pitch sessions every morning, panels and happy hours.
A speaker at Web Summit is listed as Brazil's Deputy Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation.
Serpro, the federal data service, is among the Brazilian officials speaking on the main and masterclass stages.
São Paulo state and its investment agency have speakers at Web Summit.
Invest Rio has a speaker at Web Summit.
All founder or team-member speakers with Brazil ties are in the Startup Showcase, including two of Rio de Janeiro's ten startups.
